title: Spider-Man and the missing kitten.
lines: In a big city, with tall buildings that reach the clouds, lives a young man called Peter.
He wears glasses and he loves taking photos.
When he puts on his red and blue suit, he becomes Spider-Man!
Then he can climb up walls, just like a spider.
And long, strong threads shoot out of his wrists.
That's how he makes a web.
One sunny morning Peter is walking through the park.
The birds are singing and the children are playing on the swings.
It's a little girl with a yellow coat and two pigtails.
My kitten is gone, sobs Lotte.
She's white with one black ear.
She ran away and I can't find her anywhere!
I know someone who can help you, he says.
Peter quickly goes behind a tree.
I'm going to look for Minou.
Spider-Man shoots a thread at a tall lamppost.
And he swings through the air.
He sees cars, bikes and a man with a dog.
Then he hears something very softly.
Right at the top of a tall tower, on a narrow ledge, sits a white kitten with one black ear.
It's all right, Minou, says Spider-Man.
Spider-Man climbs up the wall of the tower.
At last he's at the top.
He sits down next to Minou and talks in a soft voice.
Then she carefully steps into his arms.
But how are they going to get down?
Spider-Man shoots a long thread to the tower next door.
He makes a big web, like a soft hammock.
And off they go, sliding down the thread.
They land very gently in the park, right next to Lotte.
She hugs her kitten very tightly.
But Lotte, will you put a little bell on her collar from now on?
Then you'll always hear where she is.
Spider-Man waves and disappears behind a tree.
A little later Peter comes walking back.
She was at the top of the tower.
He takes his camera and takes a lovely photo of Lotte and Minou.
That evening, in his room, Peter thinks.
You don't always have to catch big villains, he thinks.
Saving a little kitten is very important too.
Because if you're strong, you help others.
And that's what a real hero does.
